user_query: I'm organizing a group trip for my friends and we need help with travel arrangements. Can you recommend travel portal development solutions that offer travel API integration and travel portal software? We would also like to verify the contact details of the accommodations and attractions we plan to visit. Please provide information on available APIs and their pricing.

TaskList.description: Research available travel portal development solutions that offer travel API integration.
Gather information on travel portal software options and their features.
Compile a list of travel APIs that can be integrated into the portal along with their pricing.
Verify the contact details of the accommodations booked for the trip.
Verify the contact details of the attractions planned for the trip.
